units.source_text: 古歌：“不识武藏野，闻名亦可爱。

en.t: An old poem says, "Though I do not know Musashino, even hearing its name makes it dear to me.

units.source_text: 只因生紫草，常把我心牵。”

en.t: Only because purple gromwell grows there, it always draws my heart."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu Rokucho.

units.source_text: 武藏野地方，以产紫草著名。

en.t: The Musashino region was famous for producing purple gromwell.
